title: Amazon Bedrock reinforcement fine-tuning adds support for open-weight models with OpenAI-compatible APIs
description: Amazon Bedrock now extends reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) support to popular open-weight models, including OpenAI GPT-OSS and Qwen models, and introduces OpenAI-compatible fine-tuning APIs. These capabilities make it easier for developers to improve open-weight model accuracy without requiring deep machine learning expertise or large volumes of labeled data. title: Claude Sonnet 4.6 now available in Amazon Bedrock
